name: RadScan Medical Equipment, Inc.
old_description: For over 30 years RadScan Medical Equipment has been a market-leading medical device accessory company that develops and manufactures a wide range of high quality products and accessories for various medical devices that help you safeguard and maintain your sensitive medical equipment as well as prioritizing the safety of your staff and patients.
about:
RadScan Medical Equipment, Inc. was founded in 1990 in Phoenix, Arizona, by a biomedical engineer who encountered CT scanner downtime caused by contaminants seeping under the cradle into the table interior. With CDC regulations highlighting risks of HIV and hepatitis C exposure during maintenance, he developed a preventive solution: the first CT Slicker® protective cover, which was patented and became the foundation of the company.

Today RadScan develops and manufactures a broad line of medical device accessories, including Slicker® protective covers and cushion table pads for CT, angiography, nuclear medicine, and cardiac catheterization tables. The company operates a 15,000‑square‑foot FDA‑registered and ISO 13485‑certified facility where it performs RF welding and sealing of thermoplastics (polyethylene, polypropylene, PVC, polyurethane, ABS), foam fabrication, industrial sewing, CNC precision cutting, and full product assembly. RadScan reports serving more than 40 countries, 1,600 customers, and offering over 100 imaging products.

The customer base spans original equipment manufacturers, hospitals, clinics, and a global network of dealers and distributors. RadScan partners with OEMs to co‑design new imaging accessories and also sells its branded covers and pads directly to healthcare facilities worldwide.

The company emphasizes its regulatory expertise — maintaining ISO 13485, FDA, EU MDR, RoHS, and REACH compliance — and its American‑made manufacturing as key differentiators. Its design‑to‑production capability allows it to take a concept through regulatory clearance to volume production, a service it promotes to OEMs seeking a single‑source partner.
